Created [main.py.c](/app/polyglot/main.py.c).

It works with both:

```bash
python3 /app/polyglot/main.py.c 10
gcc /app/polyglot/main.py.c -o /app/polyglot/cmain
/app/polyglot/cmain 10
```

Both print:

```text
55
```

Verified matching outputs for `N = 0, 1, 2, 10, 50, 100, 500`. The C implementation uses decimal big-integer arithmetic to avoid 64-bit overflow for larger Fibonacci values.
